exposure: Maternal complications (Preeclampsia, severe preeclampsia, thyroid dysfunction, premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: A total of 2005 dichorionic diamniotic (DCDA) and 467 monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies delivered in a single tertiary center between 2013 and 2018.
finding: Preeclampsia was associated with SGA in DCDA twin pregnancies when using twin birth weight reference (TBWR), while in MCDA twin pregnancies, SGA was associated with severe preeclampsia and a lower risk of premature rupture of membranes.
birth_weight: SGA defined as a twin with birth weight <10th centile for gestational age (using singleton or twin birth weight references)
